Pagination.title: Pagination
Pagination.description: The cursor Helix pages every list with. Twitch sends this object *empty* on the last page rather than omitting it or nulling the cursor, so an absent `cursor` is how a walk ends.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor. Pass it as the next request's `after` (or `before`, paging backwards); absent once there are no more pages.

Game.title: Game
Game.description: One category or game, as `/helix/games` and `/helix/games/top` list it.

id.description: An ID that identifies the category or game.

box_art_url.description: A URL to the category's or game's box art, with a `{width}x{height}` placeholder to replace with the size you want, in pixels.

igdb_id.description: The ID that IGDB uses to identify this game. An empty string where Twitch has no IGDB ID for it.

EventSubTransport.title: EventSubTransport
EventSubTransport.description: How Twitch delivers a subscription's notifications, as it reports them back. The fields beyond `method` are the ones that method uses.

callback.description: The HTTPS callback URL notifications are sent to, for `webhook`.

session_id.description: The WebSocket session the notifications are sent to, for `websocket`: the `id` of the `session_welcome` message that opened it.

connected_at.description: When the WebSocket connection was established, for `websocket`.

disconnected_at.description: When the WebSocket connection was lost, for `websocket`.

conduit_id.description: The conduit the notifications are sent to, for `conduit`.

EventSubSubscription.title: EventSubSubscription
EventSubSubscription.description: One EventSub subscription: what it listens for, on whose channel, and where the events go. The same shape comes back from creating one, from listing them, and inside a `notification` or `revocation` message on the socket.

id.description: An ID that identifies the subscription.

status.description: The subscription's status. Events arrive only for `enabled`. The other values say why they stopped: `webhook_callback_verification_pending`, `webhook_callback_verification_failed`, `notification_failures_exceeded`, `authorization_revoked`, `moderator_removed`, `user_removed`, `chat_user_banned`, `version_removed`, `beta_maintenance`, and the `websocket_*` and `conduit_*` reasons. Left a bare string on purpose; see the endpoint's notes.

type.description: The subscription type, such as `stream.online`, `channel.follow` or `channel.chat.message`.

version.description: The version of that subscription type, such as `1` or `2`.

condition.description: The parameter values for this subscription type: `broadcaster_user_id`, `user_id`, `moderator_user_id` and so on. Which keys are required is a fact about the subscription type, so the shape is a map of strings.

additionalProperties.description: One condition value, always a string on the wire.

transport.description: Where the notifications for this subscription are delivered.

cost.description: What this subscription counts against the application's total cost limit. A subscription the user authorized usually costs 0.
